info.name: Flying Angels - Deployment, proxy, CORS and CSRF verification
info.description:
Run once in folder order against the authenticated disposable Postman stack. Clear cookies before running. Negative 400/401/403/429 responses are intentional passing assertions. No collection-wide CSRF injection is used, so missing-token tests remain meaningful. Creates and deletes one synthetic athlete. See deployment-security-walkthrough.md.

Run every numbered folder in order from 00 - Proxy and anonymous access, one iteration. Generated fixture IDs are validated and saved automatically. Missing fixture values stop the run before an invalid URL is sent; failed fixture creation stops the run at its source. Role/authentication, CORS and CSRF rejection tests retain their expected negative responses.

Includes a six-request login-throttle check using an unknown, run-specific account. Total: 39 ordered requests. Uses default account threshold 5; server settings must match. Never targets the Admin account for lockout.

Check this response before continuing.");pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);}else{Object.keys(producedFixtureRules).forEach(key=>pm.variables.set(key,pm.collectionVariables.get(key)));}

05 - Login throttling
item.description: Five failures for a unique nonexistent email receive the normal generic 401. The next attempt receives 429 and Retry-After, including when forwarded-address headers are forged. Cooldown recovery and concurrent enforcement are covered by Java integration tests with a controllable clock. Uses the default account limit of five and 900-second block.
